blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The wealth of Vice President Sara Duterte, as declared in her statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth, will be compared with tax, bank, corporate, and other financial records, prosecutor Rep. Terry Ridon said in a press conference after Tuesday’s impeachment trial proceedings. As Ridon pointed out, the presentation of Duterte’s SALNs provided the reference point against which subsequent evidence would be tested. According to Ridon, among the evidence prosecutors intend to present are records from the Securities and Exchange Commission, Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR), Anti-Money Laundering Council, and Philippine National Police Firearms Division.
